mechanism: Only the bmmBeforeDirectRows predicate changes from `n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 2` to `n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 8`. Shapes with n>4 and 3≤p≤8 now use the proven DirectSmall scalar-dot core instead of Packed10, avoiding the 10-lane padding waste (p=3 computes 10 lanes per row today). No other runtime byte changes; native/NaN/low/underflow/preparation/output code is unchanged.
proof: Zero new proof obligations. DirectSmall.core_eq_reference and bmmPackedBase_spec are unconditional for all shapes; bmmBeforeDirectRows_spec splits on the predicate and applies the matching theorem under either branch.
prior_evidence: Public-v2 draw 1324009 class data: Packed10-routed cases with n>4 and p∈3..8 are bmm:ml:0 (1x41x3), bmm:ml:6 (8x36x3), bmm:sparse:3 (6x181x5), bmm:subnormal:3 (2x84x3), bmm:specials:1 (24x6x6), bmm:specials:4 (6x225x5). They carry about 15.9% of scored BMM work but are not separately timed in the public summary; packed-lane waste is a mechanism, not a measured gain.
first_falsifier: Same-run A/B against retained f01-d12-scalar-combined on a new public-v2 seed: BMM normalized ratio must improve enough to move the whole entry toward the 0.97 threshold with positive paired p05. A flat or slower result parks the route; no claim from operation counts.
